stem:
Rohan has to group these living things: rose, cow, cat, mango tree, hen.

Which grouping uses a valid basis from similarities and differences you can observe?

options.text: Plants that bring good luck versus plants that bring bad luck.
Animals grouped only by the place they live, with no other feature allowed.
Things that make their own food (rose, mango tree) versus things that eat food (cow, cat, hen).
Cat with cow because both names start with C.

teacher.key_rationale: A valid group uses an observable similarity: making food versus eating food. Luck is not an observed feature. Place-only is too narrow. Shared first letter is a name surface, not a living-thing feature.
